question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Q4 guide historically ≈ Q3 actual + 0.8-0.9B (Q1 guide 7.7 vs Q4FY26 actual 6.79; Q2 guide 8.5 vs Q1 actual 7.62; Q3 guide 9.2 vs Q2 actual 8.41; Q4FY26 guide 6.7 vs Q3FY26 actual 5.84). Q3 actual likely ~9.1 (actuals run slightly under guide) → ~9.9-10.0. Cross-check: full-year FY27 opex growth 'low 50s' on FY26 GAAP ~23.1B implies Q4 ~9.7-10.1B. Guidance was raised from upper-40s to low-50s; upward drift risk. No prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold.
calls.dossier:
- Q2 FY27 PR (Aug 26 2026): Q3 FY27 guide GAAP opex ~$9.2B, non-GAAP ~$9.0B. Q2 actual GAAP opex $8.408B, non-GAAP $8.232B; Q1 FY27 actual GAAP $7.621B. Starting Q1 FY27, non-GAAP no longer excludes stock-based comp (hence the small GAAP/non-GAAP gap).
- Q1 FY27 PR (May 2026): Q2 guide GAAP ~$8.5B/non-GAAP ~$8.3B. Q4 FY26 actual GAAP opex $6.794B.
- Q4 FY26 PR (Feb 2026): Q1 FY27 guide GAAP ~$7.7B/non-GAAP ~$7.5B (incl $1.9B SBC).
- Q3 FY26 (Nov 2025): Q4 FY26 guide GAAP ~$6.7B; Q3 FY26 actual GAAP ~$5.84B. FY26 GAAP opex quarters ≈ 5.03, 5.41, 5.84, 6.79 (total ~23.1B).
- Guide minus prior-quarter actual (GAAP): Q4FY26 +0.86, Q1FY27 +0.91, Q2 +0.88, Q3 +0.79. Actual vs guide: Q4FY26 6.79 vs 6.7 (above); Q1 7.62 vs 7.7; Q2 8.41 vs 8.5 (both slightly below).
- Q2 CFO commentary/call (Aug 2026): opex up 10% q/q, driven by compute infrastructure and compensation. Full-year FY27 opex growth expected in 'low 50s%', raised from 'upper 40s%' in Q1. Not clear whether that's on a GAAP or non-GAAP basis.
- Implied Q4 from full-year growth: 51-53% on GAAP FY26 ~23.1B → FY27 ~34.9-35.3B; minus Q1-Q3 (~7.62+8.41+~9.1-9.2) → Q4 ~9.6-10.1B. On a non-GAAP basis the implied figure is somewhat lower.
- Q3 FY27 earnings expected Nov 17-18, 2026.
- Status quo: NVIDIA has given a GAAP opex figure ('approximately $X') every quarter. The midpoint is that single figure.
- Resolves off the Outlook section of the Q3 FY27 press release (Q4 FY27 GAAP opex), rounded to $0.1B.
- Event window: release ~2026-11-17; as of 2026-10-31 the release hasn't happened.
- Searched: Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold, no market found. Could not find sell-side consensus for Q4 opex guidance.
calls.reference_class: NVIDIA sequential GAAP opex guidance steps, Q4 FY26-Q3 FY27 (guide minus prior-quarter actual)

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guides rose 7.7 -> 8.5 -> 9.2B, each ~0.8-0.9B above the prior quarter's actual (Q4 FY26 guide was likewise +0.86B over Q3 FY26 actual). CFO raised FY27 opex growth from 'upper 40s' (May) to 'low 50s' (Aug); against FY26 GAAP opex of ~23.08B, that implies Q4 of ~9.6-10.1B. FY2027 is a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4, so trend growth scaled for the extra week points to ~10.6-10.7B. In FY26 the Q4 guide implied ~40% growth vs a stated 'high 30s', so the stated full-year figure understates. Median ~10.2. No human market found: Polymarket/Manifold had none per the harness, and Kalshi only lists earnings-call word markets.
calls.dossier:
- Q4 FY26 PR (Feb 2026): Q4 FY26 GAAP opex actual $6.794B, Q3 FY26 actual $5.839B; Q1 FY27 guide GAAP ~$7.7B / non-GAAP $7.5B. Starting in Q1 FY27, non-GAAP includes stock-based comp (~$1.9B/qtr), so the GAAP/non-GAAP gap is now only ~$0.2B.
- FY26 GAAP opex by quarter: Q1 ~5.03, Q2 ~5.41, Q3 5.84, Q4 6.79; total ~23.08B (Q2 FY27 at 8.408 = +55% YoY, which matches the Q2 FY26 figure).
- Q1 FY27 actual GAAP opex $7.621B (guide 7.7); Q2 FY27 actual $8.408B (guide 8.5); Q3 FY27 guide ~$9.2B GAAP / $9.0B non-GAAP (Q2 FY27 PR, Aug 26 2026).

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guidance path: Q4FY26 6.7 -> Q1FY27 7.7 -> Q2 8.5 -> Q3 9.2 ($B); actuals Q1 7.62, Q2 8.41 (slightly under guide). On the Q2 FY27 call, management said full-year FY27 opex should grow in the low 50s%. FY26 GAAP opex was 23.08B, so 51-53% growth means FY27 of ~34.9-35.3B; minus Q1-Q3 (~25.2B) leaves ~9.6-10.1B for Q4. In past years Q4 opex grew 9-16% over Q3, which from a ~9.1B Q3 actual gives ~9.9-10.6B. Median ~9.95B. Upside risk: full-year growth raised or an acquisition; downside: Q3 underspend or restructuring. No Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found.

calls.reasoning: GAAP opex guide has run ~0.8-0.9B above the prior quarter's actual (7.7, 8.5, 9.2). Q3 actual likely ~9.1-9.15. The 'low 50s' full-year FY27 growth on FY26 GAAP 23.08B implies Q4 ~9.6-10.3B. FY27 is a 53-week year with a 14-week Q4, which pushes the trend toward ~10.5+. NVIDIA's full-year language understated in FY26. Median 10.1, with downside if the full-year guide is on a non-GAAP basis.
calls.reconciliation: Factual: is Q4 FY27 a 14-week quarter? Confirmed from the calendar: FY26 ended Jan 25 2026 and FY27 ends Jan 31 2027, so 53 weeks. Runs 1 and 3 did not factor this in, which justifies a move above their 9.95 median. Unresolved factual question: whether 'low 50s' is on a GAAP or the new non-GAAP basis, and whether it includes the extra week. The dossiers cannot settle it, so it is carried as width (Q4 ~9.6 non-GAAP-based vs ~10.1-10.3 GAAP-based). Judgment: how much the full-year guide caps the trend-plus-extra-week extrapolation. The FY26 understatement precedent suggests a partial cap only, so I take 10.1, slightly below Run 2 and above Runs 1 and 3. The runs report no human market (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi).
